title: The Soulmate Equation
author: Christina Lauren
summary: Jess, a statistician and single mother, signs up for a DNA-based matching app and is told her match is Gabriel, a co-founder of the company. The result makes her doubt how much to trust science over her own feelings.
readIf: you like warm, witty contemporary romances with a science setting and a smart heroine.
skipIf: you dislike matchmaking-tech plots or want more intense, dramatic romance.
